Commentary.Commentary: That's a wrap - With that, the warm-up action in Derby comes to a close. We still have one more day of warm-up action left before the main event gets underway, and that will come to you from Cardiff on Wednesday, 10 June. First up at 9 am GMT, England take on India, before Australia face West Indies at 2 pm GMT. Until then, take care and goodbye!

The stand-in skipper of Sri Lanka Women - Harshitha Samarawickrama says that they played the last 2 matches well, and they will be looking to play with the same blueprint. Mentions that they gave game time to a few players, and the way they performed is a good sign for the squad. She praises Hansima Karunaratne for taking the team over the line.

The captain of Netherlands Women - Babette de Leede, when asked for an update on the injury to Isabel Van Der Woning, replies that she does not know at the moment. Feels that they were 20 runs short with the bat. Looking at the bigger picture, Babette is pleased with the preparation leading into the World Cup and says the team will continue to take things one game at a time. Shares that the focus now shifts to their opening fixture on Sunday against Bangladesh. Points out that the Dutch beat Bangladesh last week and believes they can do so again. When asked, would that be an upset, she smiles and says that registering the Netherlands' first-ever World Cup win would be a special achievement.
Time to hear from the two captains...

Not quite enough - After the Dutch opted to bat first, Heather Siegers led the charge with a bright start, but once the field spread, they struggled to maintain that momentum. Sterre Kalis was a bit slow to start, and even though she managed to shift gears later on, the acceleration proved short-lived. Even the finish lacked the late flourish the Dutch would have hoped for, leaving them with a total that felt a little below par, given the platform they had built in the Powerplay.

Calm heads prevail - With Chamari Athapaththu resting, a lot was always going to rest on the shoulders of Sri Lanka's experienced batters, and they duly stepped up. There was a bit of a scare early on as the Dutch started brightly with the ball and asked a few questions, but the likes of Hasini Perera, Hansima Karunaratne and Harshitha Samarawickrama kept their composure. It was the unbeaten 81-run stand between Hansima and Harshitha that sealed the deal for them.

Sri Lanka get the job done - It was a tricky chase, but Sri Lanka had enough quality in their ranks to come out on top. To get over the line in a chase like this without Chamari Athapaththu will give them plenty of confidence heading into the tournament. The Netherlands will take heart from the fight they showed with the ball. They showed enough glimpses of their potential over the last couple of outings and will hope to carry those positives into the main event.

FOUR! Hansima Karunaratne hits the winning runs. Sri Lanka Women win this game by 7 wickets. Flighted, around off, Hansima Karunaratne takes it on the full and drives this through the covers region for four runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Oh dear! It is never a pleasant sight when a player goes down, and Isabel Van Der Woning appears to be in a fair bit of discomfort here. She did clutch at her hamstring earlier in the game, and it looks as though this could be the same issue flaring up again. Van Der Woning is in absolute agony, and her teammates are understandably concerned. She is being helped off the field by a couple of members of the medical staff. Let's hope it is not as serious as it looks and she is able to take part in the main event.

Full and on middle and off, Harshitha Samarawickrama looks to go big on the off side but gets an outside edge and the ball races to the right of short third for runs. It is cut off by the chasing short third fielder, saving a run for her side. Isabel Van Der Woning went after the ball from short fine leg, but she tripped and injured herself in the process. Isabel was seen holding her hamstring while she was bowling earlier in the innings. No time is ever good to sustain an injury, but there can not be a worse time than the last warm-up game before an ICC event.

Commentary.Commentary: On a back of a length, on off. Harshitha Samarawickrama angles it to backward point and the batters set off for the single. The throw from Frederique Overdijk goes well wide of the keeper and Hasini Perera gets home safely.

OUT! TIMBER! The promotion for Imesha Dulani does not quite work out as Sri Lanka had hoped. Iris Zwilling hits the top of off, it is the slower one, on a nagging length. Dulani gives the bowler the charge, looking to launch it down the ground. She swings early and fails to connect as the ball clatters into the top of the off pole.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.3: Iris Zwilling to Imesha Dulani, OUT! b Iris Zwilling.

Commentary.Commentary: A loud shout for LBW, but turned down! Fuller and angled into the pads. Imesha Dulani swings across the line and is beaten on the inside edge to be hit on the back pad.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.2: Iris Zwilling to Imesha Dulani, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: On the shorter side, angled in at the hips. Imesha helps it wide of deep fine leg for a couple of runs.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.1: Iris Zwilling to Imesha Dulani, 2 runs, played towards square leg.

Commentary.Commentary: Keeps it short, on middle. Imesha Dulani nudges it wide of mid-wicket and gets off the mark with a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.6: Frederique Overdijk to Imesha Dulani, 1 run, played towards mid wicket.

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter and quicker, on off, Dulani pushes it back to the bowler.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.5: Frederique Overdijk to Imesha Dulani, No run, played towards mid off.

Commentary.Commentary: Imesha Dulani walks out at 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Netherlands have their first wicket. Frederique Overdijk offers flight, full and on middle. Vishmi Gunarathne dances down the track and tries to hit with the spin. She fails to get the desired distance and Sterre Kalis covers good ground to her left at deep mid-wicket to take a fine catch. Sri Lanka Women are now 27/1 while chasing 144.
Commentary.Howout: c Sterre Kalis b Frederique Overdijk
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.4: Frederique Overdijk to Vishmi Gunarathne, OUT! c Sterre Kalis b Frederique Overdijk.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! The fielder in the deep should have done better there. Shorter and on middle. Vishmi Gunarathne rocks back and pulls it through square leg. The deep fielder sprints and dives but the ball trickles off her body into the fence.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.3: Frederique Overdijk to Vishmi Gunarathne, Four! Played towards square leg.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Gunarathne finds the fence this time. Flighted delivery, fuller and on middle. Vishmi Gunarathne advances down the track and pumps it back over the bowler's head. Robine Rijke at mid on turns around and puts in a slide but in vain.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.2: Frederique Overdijk to Vishmi Gunarathne, Four! Played towards mid on.

Commentary.Commentary: Just out of reach! Tossed up, on middle. Vishmi Gunarathne presses forward to go down the ground. She does not quite connect well but manages to evade the mid on and mid off fielders who tried to circle around it. A couple for Gunarathne.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.1: Frederique Overdijk to Vishmi Gunarathne, 2 runs, played towards mid off.

Commentary.Commentary: Frederique Overdijk is introduced into the attack.
Hits the top of off, does Robine. Vishmi taps it from the crease, wide of cover for one more.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.6: Robine Rijke to Vishmi Gunarathne, 1 run, played towards covers.

Commentary.Commentary: Angled into the left-hander, on a nagging length. Hasini Perera swivels to shovel it away. She does not quite get hold of it and it rolls towards backward square leg for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.5: Robine Rijke to Hasini Perera, 1 run, played towards square leg.

Commentary.Commentary: Leg bye! Floated up there, on the pads. Gunarathne misses out on the tickle. A leg bye is taken as the ball goes away to the right of short fine leg.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.4: Robine Rijke to Vishmi Gunarathne, Leg bye.

Commentary.Commentary: Just over! Robine Rijke goes full in search of swing but ends up serving a low full toss, down leg. Vishmi Gunarathne gets low to sweep it away but a top edge is found. It clears short fine leg and Heather Siegers cuts it off. Two runs taken.
